bugs.error: Review finding: nullable consent evidence/private-location deletion could retain unsafe public eligibility
bugs.root_cause: SQL NULL semantics and missing deletion handling
bugs.fix: Reject NULL/blank evidence, demote stale consent, clear projection and unpublish on private-point deletion

bugs.error: Review finding: field/gallery edits could partially alter an existing published property
bugs.root_cause: Independent REST writes lacked one publication transaction
bugs.fix: Service-only atomic admin_save_property, draft-first validation, gallery reconciliation and actor audit; failure rolls back

bugs.error: Review finding: blanket private-field regex rejects legitimate admin bundle identifiers
bugs.root_cause: Identifiers mistaken for data; early JSON return could skip JWT checks
bugs.fix: Separate private JSON/snapshot, actual secret values and service-role JWT detection; JSON continues to JWT scan

bugs.error: Review finding: import aliases, skipped rows and blank optional fields diverged between UI/server
bugs.root_cause: Mixed raw XLSX parsing and mismatched DTOs
bugs.fix: Normalize client XLSX to CSV; evidence aliases, duplicate policies, original row mapping and preserve omitted optional updates

bugs.error: SQL harness readiness failed during PostgreSQL init-server shutdown
bugs.root_cause: Unix socket readiness saw temporary server
bugs.fix: Wait on TCP 127.0.0.1; remove only owned labelled container
